attchmntText: Epigral Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Epigral Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call to the National Stock Exchange. The call, held on 02 November 2026, featured Chairman and Managing Director Maulik Patel, Executive Director Kaushal Soparkar, and Chief Financial Officer Rakesh Agrawal. For Q2 FY27, revenue grew 28% year-on-year to INR752 crores, driven by volume growth and improved realizations. EBITDA increased 3% to INR136 crores, with margins impacted by high raw material costs. Profit after tax rose 26% to INR64 crores. Half-year revenue grew 21% to INR1,461 crores, with EBITDA at INR315 crores and PAT at INR164 crores. The company reported an ROCE of 15%, or 18% excluding capital work in progress. Net debt stood at INR514 crores. Management highlighted capacity expansions for CPVC and Epichlorohydrin nearing commissioning, alongside ongoing projects for epoxy resin and a multipurpose plant.

attchmntText: Vikran Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Vikran Engineering Limited intimates that India Ratings and Research Private Limited assigned a credit rating of IND BBB+ with a Negative outlook to proposed Non-Convertible Debentures of INR 1,500 million. The agency reaffirmed existing ratings for Non-Convertible Debentures of INR 1,000 million and Bank Loan Facilities of INR 4,700 million, revising their outlook from Stable to Negative. The revision reflects substantial equity infusion requirements and elevated working capital intensity. Financial closure for NOPL Solar Projects Private Limited was achieved in October 2026, with anticipated debt drawdown expected to support project funding and improve liquidity.

attchmntText: International Conveyors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'proposed conversion of Wholly Owned Subsidiary from Public Limited Company to Private Limited Company'.
voiceSummary: International Conveyors Limited intimates that the Board of Directors of its Wholly Owned Subsidiary, International Belting Limited, approved a proposal on November 07, 2026, to convert the subsidiary from a Public Limited Company to a Private Limited Company. This change is subject to shareholder approval, approval from the Regional Director of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, and other statutory requirements. Upon completion of formalities under the Companies Act, 2013, the subsidiary's name is proposed to change from International Belting Limited to International Belting Private Limited. The conversion involves only a change in legal status and will not materially impact the business operations of International Conveyors Limited. The subsidiary will continue to remain a Wholly Owned Subsidiary.

attchmntText: Elin Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Elin Electronics Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026. Operating revenues for the quarter were Rs 413.2 crores, up 10% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs 14.1 crores, with margins declining to 3.4% due to rising raw material costs and minimum wage increases. Net profit after tax excluding extraordinary items was Rs 3.8 crores. The company reported a net debt of Rs 6.4 crores and capex spend of Rs 77.5 crores in the first half of FY27. The Bhiwadi plant commenced commercial production in mid-September 2026. Management revised full-year FY2027 revenue guidance to Rs 1400 crores, plus or minus 3%. The transcript was filed pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Laxmi Dental Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Laxmi Dental Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call with BSE and NSE. The call was held on November 04, 2026. Q2 FY27 revenue reached INR79.5 crores, a record high. EBITDA grew 38.5% to INR15.3 crores. PAT increased 17.6% to INR10 crores. H1 FY27 revenue was INR154.2 crores. PAT for the half-year was INR20.4 crores. The company received a tariff refund of INR5.5 crores. Shareholders approved updating IPO proceeds utilization. INR48.1 crores will fund manufacturing infrastructure. The transition to new facilities is expected by end of FY28. Cash and bank balances stood at INR97 crores as of September 30, 2026. The balance sheet remains debt-free.

attchmntText: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Power and Instrumentation Gujarat Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for H1FY27 was 111.57 crore rupees, up 12.96 percent year on year. EBITDA stood at 14.53 crore rupees, a 36.58 percent increase. Profit after tax was 9.26 crore rupees, up 26.36 percent. Earnings per share were 4.17 rupees. The company reported an order book of 320 crore rupees plus as of September 30, 2026. An active bid pipeline of 500 crore rupees plus is under evaluation. The company raised its stake in subsidiary Peaton Electrical to 60 percent in March 2026. Management projects 30 percent revenue growth for FY27.

attchmntText: Mamata Machinery Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Mamata Machinery Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2FY27 was 4,105 IN ₹ LAKHS, a 23% year-over-year decline. Half-year revenue was 7,732 IN ₹ LAKHS, a 16% year-over-year decline. The company reported an EBITDA loss of 555 IN ₹ LAKHS for H1FY27, compared to an EBITDA of 987 IN ₹ LAKHS in H1FY26. Profit after tax for H1FY27 was a loss of 452 IN ₹ LAKHS, versus a profit of 718 IN ₹ LAKHS in H1FY26. Management cited elevated crude oil and polymer prices, customer working capital strain, and a five-day plant shutdown due to flooding as factors affecting execution. The company stated it expects to achieve FY27 revenue on par with FY26 through higher execution in the second half.

attchmntText: FSN E Commerce Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 661020 Equity Shares pursuant to the exercise of vested stock option by employees under the Employee Stock Option schemes of the Company.

attchmntText: Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Veegaland Developers Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Pre-sales increased 37.56% year on year to Rs. 174.34 crore. Gross collections rose 88.22% year on year to Rs. 125.22 crore. Revenue from operations grew 28.66% year on year to Rs. 106.34 crore. EBITDA increased 77.76% year on year to Rs. 22.78 crore. Profit after tax rose 92.34% year on year to Rs. 15.99 crore. The total order value stands at Rs. 1086.79 crore. Unrecognised revenue is Rs. 501.35 crore. Debt-equity ratio decreased to 0.15x from 0.32x. The company has 12 ongoing projects and 3 upcoming projects.

attchmntText: Om Power Transmission Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Om Power Transmission Limited filed the transcript of its earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The company reported revenue from operations of INR 128.29 crores for Q2 FY27, a 56% growth year-on-year, and INR 249.93 crores for H1 FY27, a 46% growth. EBITDA margin for the quarter was 15.2%, with profit after tax at INR 13.85 crores. The closing order book as of September 30, 2026, stood at INR 565.99 crores, rising to approximately INR 839 crores after October wins. The company highlighted strong execution, including the commissioning of a 400 kV GIS substation at Dholera, and noted a net cash-rich position with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.08x.
